method_note: Real per-player rates from every NHL boxscore since 2024-25 (EWMA, position-mean prior, hits x home/away scorer factor), negative binomial with dispersion fitted on last season (calibration in nhl_skater_rates.json). STRONG bands unchanged: hits 3+ p 0.62-0.75, hits 2+ p 0.62-0.75, blocks 2+ p 0.58-0.72. Replaced the hand-typed PLAYER_DB on 2026-11-02 (it graded 6-15 on hits 3+ at ~67% predicted).
